[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/279d71c09f37e51ca072e75b8a77ed29c10625e8.jpg"]In addition, we have fixed several important bugs.

notes.title: NEW SCENE!
notes.content:
Dear Friends, (this update broke the game. But we fixed it. We apologize for the inconvenience. Reload Steam and update the game)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/71c280c3385ede2691e8127a48d94507be61f91e.png"]




We have added a new small sex scene to the first maze! Unfortunately, there is still no voiceover for this scene (our sound specialist has been ill), but the voiceover will be added later. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/631e594949b1a0fcd1a1a451496f0c7b7c487158.png"]



We plan on continuing to add new scenes in the future. And, after a few more weeks, maybe two, we will add a fork in the game that allows you to choose a show leader after the second maze.


Thank you for your patience! We appreciate your support.

notes.title: Gallery.
notes.content:
Dear friends, 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/f705268eae633e48c8d7ba3d67d2aa488eb0f2a0.jpg"]
The gallery is now ready! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/9575c143081b8ab272041ef1c5ba844b516e9e4e.png"]

The next step is to create an improved save system, and we will also start adding new sex scenes!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/afbc3573c2a7623df9c1d16cf7aa38272b59482e.png"]

Your support is very important to us! The more players we have, the more we can add new content.

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/72731619345c46cfe631768a8312c927bd9d6700.png"]
We have a big request. Could you please update the game, launch it, play for a while and let us know if the achievements are working correctly?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/fa283d43201dcf9e76a3d38311e378e34c6d3bc1.png"]

The gallery is almost ready.

notes.title: Gallery and Important News!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/817e001ef1db3acbefaa3c280fc32b0d5dd83819.jpg"]


We regret to inform you that due to some recent circumstances, we have been forced to remove certain scenes and apply censorship. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/f705268eae633e48c8d7ba3d67d2aa488eb0f2a0.jpg"]

Unfortunately, some of the censorship has been applied automatically even to scenes that did not require it. We are working to fix this issue.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/45389df1fbcf640971edd6b5c59d31b347bc8c26.png"]


Additionally, because of these circumstances, we had to remove the gallery and start over. The gallery will become available again in the near future.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/6beb383043dd96e06465176ba9140eb9f2395368.jpg"]


Your support is greatly appreciated at this time. We hope that we can resolve any issues in the future! 

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

I'm sorry to inform you that the internet has been temporarily unavailable in my area due to concerns regarding drones. As a result, I had to request another developer to publish an older build. This version contains a bug that prevents the game from starting + some audio bug. 

To start the game, please navigate to the "CHAPTERS" section in the main menu, which is represented by circles at the top.

Unfortunately, I am still unable to upload any new content. I have transferred the necessary permissions to my colleague, who will be uploading a new build soon. This build will be free from the bug.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/d890d29863e9b2ce69a9ef95df0952fe9ee846fe.jpg"]
Dear Friends! 

We are thrilled to announce the release date for our upcoming project "Futa Runner", which will be released on August 22nd. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/bba4ba4bbc40850fc0ced201f6ab95921731c6b7.png"]
While you wait for the release, we would appreciate your help with the promotion. Please spread the word about the game among your friends and add it to your wishlist. 
Thank you for your support!

notes.title: FEST DEMO!!!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/c2247d8c0b37ab42f8a7d2a06978577180547866.jpg"]Today is the start of Steam Next Fest!

We have decided to participate with our game - "Futa Runner".

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/bba4ba4bbc40850fc0ced201f6ab95921731c6b7.png"]A small, raw demo will be available for you to play during the week.

The game is about a man born without an anus. It's a brave and uninteresting story.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45368356/d890d29863e9b2ce69a9ef95df0952fe9ee846fe.jpg"]

We ask that you play the Futa Runner demo and tell your friends about "Futa Runner".

We'll add a test map with parkour soon.




 P.S. game is complete crap.
